output.question: What are C&S Wholesale Grocers' subsidiaries?
output.answer: C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC calls its subsidiaries the 'C&S family of companies'. It names them as Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash. SpartanNash joined when C&S completed its acquisition on September 22, 2025. C&S also runs more than 200 corporate grocery stores, mainly under the D&W Fresh Market, Grand Union, Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly banners. These are store banners, not separate subsidiaries. On August 13, 2026, C&S proposed to become majority owner of The Winn-Dixie Company, which would add Winn-Dixie. That deal is expected to close in 2027 and was not complete as of the latest reports.

key_facts.fact: The C&S family of companies includes Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash.
C&S completed its acquisition of SpartanNash; the press release carrying the same family-of-companies list is dated September 22, 2025.
C&S operates more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores, mainly under the D&W Fresh Market, Grand Union, Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly banners.
On August 13, 2026, C&S proposed a transaction to become majority owner of The Winn-Dixie Company, expected to close in 2027.

caveats: The list comes from C&S's own boilerplate, which names companies with the word 'including'. It may not be a complete legal list of subsidiaries. C&S is privately held and does not publish a subsidiary schedule.
SpartanNash has its own subsidiaries and retail banners, such as Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets, D&W Fresh Market and VG's Grocery. These sit under C&S indirectly.

The Winn-Dixie majority-ownership deal was proposed but not completed as of the latest reports I found, with closing expected in 2027. Search snippets say C&S already holds a minority stake from the 2025 investor-group purchase of Southeastern Grocers/Winn-Dixie from Aldi, but I could not confirm this on a page I opened.
The cswg.com and Business Wire pages returned 403 errors. The family-of-companies list was confirmed on C&S's careers page and a syndicated copy of the Business Wire release.
